lines.text: Jesus tells Pergamum He knows they live where the throne of Satan sits, yet they hold fast to His name.
Jesus says some in Pergamum hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak, king of Moab, to place a stumbling block before the Israelites.
Jesus promises the one who overcomes the hidden manna and a white stone inscribed with the Ten Commandments.
Jesus tells Thyatira that He knows their deeds, but they tolerate Jezebel, who misleads His servants, and she is unwilling to repent.
Jesus promises the one who overcomes authority over the nations, received from His prophets, to rule them with an iron scepter.
